# FLX-3002: binary floating-point value at the seam

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

KERNEL-SPEC §9 ends with 'float -&gt; FLX-3002' and §2.1 forbids a float anywhere in a hashed value: a binary float has no reproducible spelling across platforms and libm versions, so a stream containing one cannot be replayed. Carry the number as an int or a decimal.Decimal, which the seam renders exactly.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3002
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
